segments.text: What if I told you Silly Putty and Chick-fil-A share ingredients? Chick-fil-A deep fries their chicken in refined peanut oil. When heated to high temperatures, seed oils form aldehydes, which are cancer-causing toxins. On top of that, deep frying the batter creates AGEs, which can disrupt your blood vessels, skin, and accelerate aging.

But, that's not it. They add a compound called PDMS to their oil, which is the same ingredient used in Silly Putty. Makes me feel hungry. >> Two of those, please. >> One Chick-fil-A sandwich has over 1,400 mg of sodium. That's 97% of the American Heart Association's ideal daily limit.

But look, their website says made with quality ingredients. 55 ingredients, including preservatives that can increase DNA mutations and leavening agents that contain aluminum. Let's see these 55 ingredients. One, two, and pickles. Something's not adding up. The fact that they've normalized this to us, good job on them, but you know, sad for us. In 2022, Chick-fil-A sold 527 million fried chicken sandwiches. That's a lot of that. I don't know, you guys.
What have we gotten ourselves into? Chick-fil-A literally hands you garbage and says, "My pleasure." The best thing they do for your health is close on Sundays.
